findings.evidence: A changed element identity exited before ZoneKit and rolled pending selector state back.
Registry compare-before-restore preserved a later selector name. Out-of-order undo against the global ZoneKit stack is outside this contract.

Muted helper zone is excluded from reuse; its existing committed mapping cannot target it while muted.
